title: AS-REP Roasting: Pre-Auth-Disabled RC4 AS-REQ (Event 4768)
description: Detects AS-REP roasting at the wire level: a Kerberos AS-REQ (Event 4768) for an account that does not require pre-authentication, returned with RC4 (TicketEncryptionType 0x17). Roastable AS-REPs encrypted with RC4 are the crackable artifact harvested by Rubeus asreproast and GetNPUsers.py.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and (('Event ID' = '4768' and 'Ticket Encryption Type' = '0x17') and not ('Target User Name' like '*$'))
falsepositives: Legacy accounts using RC4 and disabled pre-authentication
